rules.message: Frontmatter is missing or cannot be parsed.
rules.fix: Start SKILL.md with a closed YAML frontmatter block (--- ... ---) using plain scalars, quoted strings, block scalars or inline lists.
rules.why: Without parseable frontmatter the skill has no name or description, so it cannot be discovered or triggered.

rules.message: The `name` field is missing.
rules.fix: Add a `name` field to the frontmatter.
rules.why: The name identifies the skill and is required by the Agent Skills spec.

rules.message: The `name` is not a valid skill name (max 64 characters, only a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen).
rules.fix: Rename to lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.
rules.why: Invalid names are rejected or mishandled by skill loaders.

rules.message: The `name` does not match the skill's folder name.
rules.fix: Rename the folder or the `name` so they match.
rules.why: The spec expects the name to equal the parent directory name; a mismatch confuses loaders and readers.

rules.message: The `name` contains a reserved word (`anthropic` or `claude`).
rules.fix: Choose a name without `anthropic` or `claude`.
rules.why: Those words are reserved and may be rejected.

rules.message: The `name` is vague (helper, utils, tools, documents, data or files).
rules.fix: Use a specific name that says what the skill does.
rules.why: Vague names make skills hard to tell apart and to select.

rules.message: The `description` is missing or empty.
rules.fix: Write a description of what the skill does and when to use it.
rules.why: The description is what the model uses to decide whether to load the skill.

rules.message: The `description` is longer than 1024 characters.
rules.fix: Shorten the description to 1024 characters or fewer.
rules.why: Over-long descriptions are truncated or rejected and bloat every session's context.

rules.message: `description` plus `when_to_use` is longer than 1536 characters.
rules.fix: Shorten the combined text to 1536 characters or fewer.
rules.why: Claude Code truncates the combined listing text, which can cut off trigger phrases.

rules.message: The `name` or `description` contains XML tags.
rules.fix: Remove the XML or HTML tags from the name and description.
rules.why: Tags are not allowed in these fields and can interfere with prompt handling.

rules.message: The `description` uses first or second person (for example "I can", "you can", "help me").
rules.fix: Rewrite in the third person, for example "Cleans CSV files".
rules.why: Descriptions are injected into the system prompt; mixed point of view hurts discovery.

rules.message: The `description` is shorter than 40 characters.
rules.fix: Expand it to say what the skill does and when to use it.
rules.why: Very short descriptions give the model too little to match against.

rules.message: The `description` has no "when" clause (use when, when the user, whenever, use this, use for).
rules.fix: Add a clause saying when the skill should be used.
rules.why: Trigger conditions in the description improve selection accuracy.

rules.message: The SKILL.md body is over the line limit.
rules.fix: Move detail into referenced files and keep the body concise.
rules.why: Long bodies consume context every time the skill loads.

rules.message: The SKILL.md body is over the token estimate limit (characters divided by 4).
rules.fix: Trim the body or split it into referenced files.
rules.why: Large bodies consume context every time the skill loads.

rules.message: A referenced file does not exist.
rules.fix: Create the file or remove the reference.
rules.why: Broken references leave the agent without the content it was told to read.

rules.message: A reference resolves outside the reviewed root.
rules.fix: Keep referenced files inside the skill or repository.
rules.why: Reaching outside the root can expose unrelated files and is not portable.

rules.message: A file is reachable only through another referenced file (depth greater than 1).
rules.fix: Link the file directly from SKILL.md.
rules.why: Nested references are often read only partially.

rules.message: A referenced file is over the length limit and has no table of contents near the top.
rules.fix: Add a table of contents (a list of headings or links) within the first lines.
rules.why: A contents list lets the agent find the right section without reading the whole file.

rules.message: The instructions use a Windows-style backslash path.
rules.fix: Use forward slashes in paths.
rules.why: Backslash paths fail on non-Windows systems.

rules.message: The text contains a date-dependent statement ("as of <year>", "before/after <month> <year>", or "currently" followed by a version).
rules.fix: Remove the dated statement or move it to a clearly marked legacy section.
rules.why: Time-sensitive statements go stale and mislead.

rules.message: Another skill in this run has the same `name`.
rules.fix: Give each skill a unique name.
rules.why: Duplicate names make skills indistinguishable and one may shadow the other.

rules.message: The skill file is named `skill.md` rather than `SKILL.md`.
rules.fix: Rename the file to `SKILL.md`.
rules.why: The spec requires the exact name SKILL.md; some loaders on case-sensitive systems will not find it.

rules.message: `allowed-tools` grants unrestricted shell access (Bash, Bash(*) or Bash(* *)).
rules.fix: Restrict Bash to specific commands, for example `Bash(git:*)`.
rules.why: Unrestricted shell removes the permission prompt for any command.

rules.message: The skill can perform irreversible actions and does not set `disable-model-invocation`.
rules.fix: Add `disable-model-invocation: true` so the skill runs only when the user invokes it.
rules.why: Irreversible actions should not be triggered automatically by the model.
